## Config.includeFontPadding property

Controls whether Android text measurement includes the font's top and bottom padding. When enabled, page config forwards `includeFontPadding` to text shadow nodes and text height or vertical centering includes font padding; when disabled, text metrics exclude that padding. When omitted, Android falls back to the historical SDK-based default (`true` for 2.4 &lt;<!-- -->= target SDK &lt; 2.9).

Supported platform: Android

Since: LynxSDK 3.2

**Signature:**

```typescript
includeFontPadding?: boolean;
```

## Default Value

false
